newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Australand IPO in Singapore oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Australand IPO in Singapore oversubscribed.

text.p: The initial public offer of Australand Holdings Ltd, a subsidiary of DBS Land, was 7.17 times subscribed at the close of the offer by midday on Thursday, the company said.
Australand said in a statement applications amounting to 41.4 million shares were received for the 5.8 million share offered to the public.

"We are pleased that in spite of weak market conditions in Singapore, Australand's shares have been well received by the Singapore public following (the) strong response by Australian retail investors," Australand Managing Director Brendan Crotty said.
Trading of Australand's shares in Singapore and Australia is expected to begin on June 16, it said.
The proceeds from the share offer will be used as additional working capital for the expansion of the Australand Group.
